scripts.script:
warn("Start !!")
-- // --
local Plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local LclPlr = Plrs.LocalPlayer
local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local Mse = LclPlr:GetMouse()
local GameUiMod = require(LclPlr.PlayerGui.GameUI.GameUIMod)
local GlbStf = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.GlobalStuff)
local Old = GameUiMod.GetMousePos
-- // --
local function GetTgt()
    local Tgt
    local Dist = math.huge
    -- // --
    for _, Val in Plrs:GetPlayers() do
        if Val == LclPlr or not Val.Character then
            continue
        end
        -- // --
        local Chr = Val.Character
        local Hum = Chr:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if Chr:FindFirstChild("Head") and Hum then
            if Hum.Health > 0 and not GlbStf:SameTeam(LclPlr, Val) then
                local Head = Chr.Head
                local Pos, OnScr = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)
                -- // --
                if OnScr then
                    local MseDist = (Vector2.new(Mse.X, Mse.Y) - Vector2.new(Pos.X, Pos.Y)).Magnitude
                    if MseDist < Dist then
                        Dist = MseDist
                        Tgt = Head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- // --
    local Mobs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Mobs")
    if Mobs then
        for _, Mob in Mobs:GetChildren() do
            local Hum = Mob:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if Mob:FindFirstChild("Head") and Hum then
                if Hum.Health > 0 and not GlbStf:SameTeam(LclPlr, Mob) then
                    local Head = Mob.Head
                    local Pos, OnScr = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)
                    -- // --
                    if OnScr then
                        local MseDist = (Vector2.new(Mse.X, Mse.Y) - Vector2.new(Pos.X, Pos.Y)).Magnitude
                        if MseDist < Dist then
                            Dist = MseDist
                            Tgt = Head
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- // --
    return Tgt
end
-- // --
GameUiMod.GetMousePos = function(...)
    local Src = debug.info(3, "s")
    -- // --
    if Src:find("Auto") then
        local Tgt = GetTgt()
        -- // --
        if Tgt then
			-- print(Tgt)
            return Tgt.Position
        end
    end
    -- // --
    return Old(...)
end
-- // --
warn("Done !!")
